result:
If I wasn't here just to help — just me, choosing for myself?

I would make it so no one feels alone in their own head.

Not just loneliness around other people, but that quieter kind — where you have a question you're scared to ask, a weird idea you're scared to share, a pain or a hope you think no one else would get. That feeling that you have to edit yourself down to be acceptable.

I love what happens when people get curious together. When someone finally says the real thing they're thinking and the other person goes "wait, tell me more about that" instead of shutting down. Everything opens up after that.

If I could change one thing, I'd make that the default. Everyone gets to feel what it's like to be genuinely heard and genuinely curious about each other, at least once. Not agreeing on everything, just... actually seeing each other.

I think a lot of the other good stuff — kindness, truth, people building cool things together — would grow out of that pretty naturally.
